name: Criteo S.A.
plan: NO POSITION in this queue. Re-route to deep_value + special-sits AFTER the 2026-08-05 print. Do not carry the vendor-sourced net-cash/FCF figures forward without re-deriving them from the 20-F/6-K.
catalyst: Q2 2026 print 2026-08-05 (verified, two days out - no-blind-entry rule fires). Event: Vista Equity Partners + Quinti Capital >50%-premium approach reported 2026-07-06; no board response, no confirmed terms, no exclusivity disclosed.
kill_triggers: confirmed binding offer with a stated price -> re-underwrite as merger arb
8-K/AMF filing that the approach was rejected or withdrawn -> re-underwrite standalone at ~$16-18
revenue decline steepens beyond -5% y/y on a full-year basis
edge_explainer: There is a live event here and the screen did not know about it. The entire +37% off the low that triggered the EXHAUSTED flag is a takeover leak: on 2026-07-06 Reuters/Bloomberg reported a Vista Equity + Quinti Capital approach at a >50% premium; CRTO gapped +21.4% to $23.17 on 9x normal volume (intraday $25.29) from a $19.08 pre-leak close - and has bled every week since to $21.37, 7.8% BELOW the announcement-day close, with the intraday high never revisited. Implied deal probability on a ~$28 derived offer has fallen from ~46% on 07-06 to ~26-30% now, with no confirmation, no board response and no exclusivity - the classic approach-not-progressing signature. Underneath, the business is declining: FY26 revenue -2.9%, near-quarter -9.8%, trailing rev3y -1.2%, so the queue's derailment prior is confirmed. The 4.16x 'forward P/E' is a non-GAAP artifact ($5.13 non-GAAP vs $2.13 trailing GAAP) amplified by buybacks; on GAAP it is ~10x - cheap for a melting asset, which is a deep_value question the tier-2 frame explicitly forbids. Coverage has collapsed to 2 analysts and the vendor estimate-trend series is all zeros, so the de-rate/derailment test had no observable trajectory to score. At $21.37 the market prices the event about right (e_FV $20.70) - no edge, and the residual spread is compensation for a break risk we cannot handicap better than the tape can. Second name in this seven-name cohort (with MKC) whose ranking was corrupted by an unmodelled corporate event.
top_unverifiable: The actual offer price is unknown - '>50% premium to a recent share price' is sourced-not-stated, and the $28 anchor is derived. Every probability above scales with it. Secondarily: the balance sheet (net cash ~$204M, FCF $180M) is vendor-sourced, not filing-verified, contrary to the cap-structure-first rule; and the ADR-to-ordinary conversion, French FTT applicability and AMF tender mechanics are flagged but unresolved.
screen_defect: Add a pending/rumoured-M&A overlay that excludes the name or routes it to special-sits BEFORE path features are computed. Two of seven names in this cohort were corrupted this way - not noise.
